name: Oyèrónkẹ́ Oyěwùmí
shortBio: Nigerian feminist philosopher and sociologist who demonstrated that precolonial Yorùbá society was organized by seniority rather than biological gender, exposing Western feminism’s bio-logical universalism.
centralQuestion: Is "gender" a universal human ontology, or a Western visual-biological construct imposed onto non-Western cultures through colonialism?

keyWorks.title: The Invention of Women: Making an African Sense of Western Gender Discourses
keyWorks.description: Challenges Western "bio-logic" by showing Yorùbá kinship categories (obinrin/okunrin, iyá) lacked hierarchical Western gender.
